rubric.role_summary: Senior product management role leading strategy and execution for account verification products used to connect and verify financial accounts, including verification experiences across Auth, Balance, and Identity Match.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product management role leading strategy and execution for account verification products used to connect and verify financial accounts, including verification experiences across Auth, Balance, and Identity Match.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of experience, including 5+ years in product management or equivalent founder/operator roles.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience building and scaling products in fintech or payments.
- Proven success building and scaling products.
- Track record of cross-functional impact with design, engineering, and go-to-market teams to deliver results.
- Hands-on use of data and AI tools for writing, analysis, prototyping, and experimentation.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
